title: Characters
summary: Each character starts with one weapon, has its own inventory shape and a Burst Skill you trigger by hand.

sections.title: Ark Leon: Leon Shooter
items: Unleashes a barrage of bombs, dealing damage to enemies.
15 slots at the start (■), 66 more can be opened with expansion points (□)

sections.title: Ark Leon: Lander Arm
items: Takes time to regroup, restoring the barricade's HP and temporarily reducing reload time.
Repair + faster reload (values 2000 / 1000 / 5; meaning not documented)
15 slots at the start (■), 66 more can be opened with expansion points (□)

sections.title: Ark Leon: Falcon Wings
items: Shoots a high-temperature blade, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them backward.
15 slots at the start (■), 66 more can be opened with expansion points (□)

sections.title: Ark Leon: Lander Pack
items: Fires laser beams, dealing damage to enemies and lowering their DEF for a certain time.
15 slots at the start (■), 66 more can be opened with expansion points (□)

sections.title: Ark Buster
items: Fires gravity balls that gradually grow bigger, attracting enemies nearby. The gravity balls will explode after a certain time, dealing damage to enemies.
15 slots at the start (■), 66 more can be opened with expansion points (□)
